additional_info.subject: ID0424063-DC/Si-D/BE- [MP / PD 170001327] Disabled the screen CRM:00315002638
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
Ms. Chloë raised a ticket about a faulty HMI. Please check the 24V supply to the controller and if there is 24V at the input, and the HMI is still dark, please check if the DP cable is also not the issue, if not, please replace the HMI.
If there are no 24V at the input, please check the power supply from before where we are losing the 24V:
You can also check if FC14 is tripped and that's why it's not providing 24V:
If FC14 is tripped, please try and change the 24V from XD21:4C to FC17 from either these 2 connectors:
If it's still not improved then replace the HMI.
